actual: MA-E19 deterministic replica produced identical full prediction ordering and identical minute/risk/suspend inputs, but portfolio holdings diverged on equal-score candidates. scripts/score_weighted_strategy_v2.py converts ranked Top-K to set, iterates the set, then sorts buy candidates only by score; equal scores preserve randomized hash iteration order across fresh Python processes. This changes selected orders, positions and TWAP portfolio returns, invalidating matched staleness comparisons. Preserve score/rank business semantics while enforcing deterministic tie order and add fresh-process regression evidence.
